{{Quote|The crystal belongs to Kaink, the Ewok Priestess.|The Narrator|<ref name="Caravan" />}}
The '''Crystal''' was a sacred [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] item that once belonged to an ancient Ewok warrior. The Crystal was a white semi-transparent crystal held by a few twigs, fastened by rope. While being used, the crystal glowed green, and the eyes of the one under the effect of the crystal's power also glowed green.<ref name="Caravan" /> 

==History==
Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], prior to the journey to locate and rescue the parents of the shipwrecked [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Mace Towani|Mace]] and [[Cindel Towani]] from a [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], the crystal was given to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Deej Warrick]] in hopes that along the journey, the caravan would find two new Ewoks to join them on their journey by the village shaman, [[Logray/Legends|Logray]].<ref name="Caravan" /> 

On the journey, the group discovers [[Kaink/Legends|Kaink]], the Ewok [[Priestess/Legends|Priestess]]. Deej offered the crystal to Kaink, who accepts it, however, the crystal is not enough to convince Kaink to join the caravan, asking the group to pass a magic test. Kaink asks Mace first to take the test, giving the crystal to him. When Mace holds on to the crystal, it turns into a [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]. Mace drops the lizard to the ground and begins to walk away, not believing that Kaink will help them. As Mace leaves, Cindel picks up the lizard, turning it into a [[Mouse/Legends|mouse]], passing the test and convincing Kaink to join the group.<ref name="Caravan" />

Sometime after this test, the mouse is turned back into the crystal, and Kaink adds the crystal to the top of her staff. Later, the caravan reaches the [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax]]. Inside the Fortress, the caravan crosses a large spider web situated above a massive ravine to get from one side of the ravine to the other. During the crossing, Deej is attacked by a [[Rearing spider]]. Kaink saves Deej from the attack by using the crystal to briefly hypnotize the spider, paralyzing it briefly and allowing Deej to escape.<ref name="Caravan" />
